title: Example bundle: monthly NDVI (synthetic)
description:
Synthetic example: every identifier contains 'example' (Item IDs are period keys) and every value, checksum, size and date is invented to show the format. Nothing was computed from imagery. The analysis geometry is a synthetic outline, not the valley catchment. A real bundle links one Item per period from 2019-01 to 2025-12; this example links only period_2022-04.

Monthly NDVI from masked, harmonized Sentinel-2 L2A reflectance (scene classification mask only, reduced QA). The spatial IQR describes variability across pixels, not a confidence interval.

providers.name: Siterra science pipeline
providers.processing:lineage: Deduplicated tile-date items, harmonized reflectance offsets, scene classification mask, NDVI per observation, per-pixel monthly median, area summaries over the analysis geometry (docs/reference/observation-preprocessing.md).

siterra:dataset.access_route: Earth Search STAC API https://earth-search.aws.element84.com/v1/, collection sentinel-2-l2a

siterra:geo_selection.area_method: Planar area of the synthetic outline in EPSG:32629 (UTM 29N)

operation_order: keep the newest processing baseline per tile and sensing date
harmonize the reflectance offset for processing baseline 04.00 and later
mask scene classification classes other than 4 and 5
drop pixels with fewer accepted dates than the minimum
summarize the area median and spatial IQR over accepted pixels

siterra:limitations: Synthetic example: no value was computed from imagery.
Reduced QA (scene classification only): snow and terrain shadow can survive the mask.
The spatial IQR is variability across pixels, not a confidence interval.
